Choose where to open your desktop.
On this device
The desktop bundled in this app, as a guest. Sign-in, sync, mail and Agents are not available. Your data stays on this phone and is never uploaded.
Open on this device
Cloud server

Opens your MvL OS server full screen inside the app. Signing in with GitHub or Google opens your browser briefly and comes back here; that needs a server with app sign-in. The server\'s desktop gets no access to the phone beyond what a website has. Data on this device is separate and is never uploaded or merged.

Signs the app out of this server and deletes everything the app kept for it (cookies, its saved data and cache), then forgets the address. Your browser is not affected: if you use the site there too, it stays signed in until you sign out there.

%1$s supports app sign-in but is not set up for it: its admin has to set PUBLIC_URL to exactly this https:// address. You can keep using it here as a guest, or sign in on the site in a browser.

GitHub\'s and Google\'s pages never open inside the app. Linking another sign-in, connecting Google Calendar or allowing private repositories needs a browser: open %1$s in your browser, sign in there and do it there. It then applies here too.
